title: SC announces suspension of court operations on Wednesday, November 4, 2026
summary: The Supreme Court announced that operations in some courts in the country are suspended on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 due to power interruption and local holidays.

blocks.text: The Supreme Court announced that operations in some courts in the country are suspended on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 due to power interruption and local holidays.
The court operations in the following areas are suspended:

items: All courts in the Province of Quezon - death anniversary of its local hero, Apolinario Dela Cruz, also known as Hermano Puli
MTC Minalabac, Camarines Sur - power interruption
All courts in San Carlos, Negros Occidental - annual fiesta
All courts in Bohol - birth anniversary of the late President Carlos P. Garcia

blocks.text: Refresh this page for updates. — BAP, GMA News
